title: Google Ads Coach and 1-on-1 Training with Sheldon Payne

facts.fact: Sheldon Payne's Google Ads coaching page offers a free 30-minute discovery call as the first step.
Per the page, the coaching begins with a 30-minute discovery call held via Zoom.
facts.quote: My coaching will start with a 30 minute discovery call via Zoom.

facts.fact: Sheldon Payne states he has provided digital marketing campaigns to Small, Medium and Fortune 100 companies for over 19 years.
facts.quote: A Certified Google Ads Professional, I have been providing Small, Medium and Fortune 100 companies with forward-thinking digital marketing campaigns for over 19 years.

facts.fact: Sheldon Payne states he started his own digital marketing agency, Newfound Marketing, in 2012.
facts.quote: Prior to starting my own digital marketing agency in 2012 called Newfound Marketing

facts.fact: The page states that its typical coaching client falls into one of 3 categories.
facts.quote: My typical coaching client will fall into one of 3 categories:

facts.fact: The page lists 13 coaching focus areas, including campaign set-up, conversion tracking, and keyword match types, that are set after the discovery call.
facts.quote: Based on the outcome of this will we will set a plan in place to work on any of the following areas to improve your current results.
